_note: Lengths are proximal-distal extents in mm. Finger values are per-finger means from heras2024 (Table 1 and Table 2); thumb values are the type III (most frequent) means from gnanasekaran2018 (Tables 1 and 2). Positions along the bone are DERIVED by chaining these lengths and gaps from the stated joint anchors and fitting them to this model's bone lengths; they are not measured positions. status=sourced means lengths and incidence were checked against the paper's tables; position_status=derived means placement still needs expert review.

heras2024.citation: De Las Heras J, Simón de Blas C, et al. What is new in flexor tendon pulleys and the gaps between them in triphalangeal fingers of the hand? J Anat. 2024.
heras2024.sample: 192 triphalangeal fingers from 48 fresh donor hands
heras2024.reuse: facts cited only; article is CC BY-NC-ND, no text or figures reused

gnanasekaran2018.citation: Gnanasekaran D, Veeramani R, Karuppusamy A. Morphometric study of pulleys of the thumb. Anat Cell Biol. 2018;51(2):71.
gnanasekaran2018.reuse: facts cited only; article is CC BY-NC, no text or figures reused

A1.anchor: from the MCP palmar plate to the proximal part of the proximal phalanx

C1.anchor: distal third of the proximal phalanx

C2.anchor: proximal third of the middle phalanx

A5._note: ring-finger cell in the published table reads 31.19, an evident misprint; the global mean 2.75 is used instead

fingers.pattern_note: All eight pulleys together were found in only 3 of 192 fingers (1.56%); the most frequent pattern was A1-A2-C1-A3-A4 (18.22%). The model shows the full classical set as a reference scheme; the app must present C2, C3 and A5 as frequently absent.

thumb.type_modelled: III (54.55% of thumbs): A1, Av, oblique and A2 all present, Av fibres oblique

A1.anchor: anterior to the MCP joint, extending to the base of the proximal phalanx

Av.anchor: proximal part of the proximal phalanx

unverified: Direction of the oblique pulley (ulnar proximally to radial distally) follows the classical description and the paper's wording for type III Av fibres; not yet checked against a primary source for the oblique pulley itself.
